_public_export.scope: Historical claims and verification records retain their original scope. Priority 1 cyclicity is even L2 only; full-ground capture and RH remain open.

B_scope: The prescribed proxy is the arithmetic image of a mean-zero combination of prolate modes 0 and 4; it is not the minimizer or a stationary point of the ordinary full even mean-zero concentration problem.
numerical_scope: 288-bit Arb matrix midpoints and 75-digit eigenscoring of rounded floating-point trial coefficients; eigenvalues, gaps, scores, and the exact prolate proxy are not interval-certified.
known_radical_relation_source: Connes-Consani, Spectral triples and zeta-cycles, Section 3, pp.118-120
G_star_sufficient_rate: For every 0<r<1/2, sqrt((lambda^(2r)-1)/r) * (||P_N k_lambda||_2 sqrt(excess/gap) + ||(I-P_N)k_lambda||_2) -> 0, together with the actual ES condition and known proxy convergence.
current_obstruction: No RH-independent quantitative control of the actual proxy energy excess relative to the full Weil ground gap, with projection and growing-window Fourier losses; the known arithmetic radical relation does not select a unique ground state.
recommended_next_action: STOP_THIS_LIMITED_TRACK; no fourth renamed mechanism and no automatic proof-graph merge.
